channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Alec Burks | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Alec Burks from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Andy Elisburg on Alec Burks
item.description:
“He’s one of those players that over the years Spo and Pat have always said, ‘Hey, we like Alec Burks,’ and just never could find something that works. It was always in my group of players in that list that came through. So it’s been for a number of years having that conversation. So when the opportunity came this year that he was willing to come to us and willing to come to us at a minimum, we could finally get Alec Burks here.”

Andy Elisburg on Alec Burks, Jul 15, 2024. Source: South Florida Sun-Sentinel.

item.title: Monty Williams on Alec Burks
item.description:
Monty on Burks:

“When he gets it going like that, guys feed off of that because he’s the same guy every day — same attitude, same work ethic. Seeing him go off, our bench was going crazy.”

Monty Williams on Alec Burks, Jan 15, 2024. Source: Twitter @omarisankofa.

item.title: Monty Williams on Alec Burks
item.description:
Williams said after practice on Tuesday.

“You have to have some really good vets who know how to play. They settle us down a little bit, their voice is good on the floor, they know how to space, they know how to make the right plays. I told (Burks) today he got it going a little bit. I told him that’s who you have to be. You have to be yourself. He’s been defending and competing, and that’s something that we value.”

Monty Williams on Alec Burks, Oct 11, 2023. Source: Detroit Free Press.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Bojan Bogdanovic, Alec Burks
item.description:
Mike Curtis:Dwane Casey on Alec Burks/Bojan Bogdanovic:

“He’s that veteran you want on your team going forward…He and Bogey are the perfect fit for our rebuilding programwhen we’re ready to go forward and take off next year. Those two are just important pieces now and also going forward.”

Dwane Casey on Bojan Bogdanovic, Alec Burks, Feb 8, 2023. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Alec Burks
item.description:
Mike Curtis:Tom Thibodeau on Alec Burks:

“Alec's great and a consummate pro. Just a great teammate. Very coachable. Great person. That's really been the story of his career. Everywhere he's been, people love him. There's a reason why. Just a high character guy.”

Tom Thibodeau on Alec Burks, Nov 11, 2022. Source: Twitter @MikeACurtis2.

item.title: Dwane Casey on Alec Burks
item.description:
James Edwards III:Casey on the Pistons being middle of the pack shooting the 3, even with many unlucky bounces:

“I think we have potential to be even better. That's our goal.... We're missing Alec Burks. Three-point shooting is one of those things that's contagious. We want to stay there.”

Dwane Casey on Alec Burks, Oct 25, 2022. Source: Twitter @JLEdwardsIII.

item.title: Steve Kerr on Alec Burks
item.description:
Eric Walden:Warriors coach Steve Kerr, on former Jazzman Alec Burks:

“We’re so young that (teammates) call him ‘Old Man.’ ... He’s very well-respected.... The reason I like him is there’s no drama. He just shows up to work every day ... and whether he plays well or not, he’s just poised.”

Steve Kerr on Alec Burks, Nov 22, 2019. Source: Twitter @tribjazz.

item.title: Yogi Ferrell on Alec Burks
item.description:
Jason Anderson:Here's @Sacramento Kings guard Yogi Ferrell on new teammate Alec Burks:

“I just know that he attacks the rim, so I feel he'll fit in well with us with his ability to get in the paint and create.”

Yogi Ferrell on Alec Burks, Feb 6, 2019. Source: Twitter @JandersonSacBee.

item.title: Ricky Rubio on Alec Burks
item.description:
Even with the Jazz winning seven of their last eight games, players understand the NBA is a business always in search of better opportunities — hence, former Jazzman Alec Burks learning he was traded for Kyle Korver ahead of the Jazz’s road contest versus Brooklyn in November.

“Sometimes we forget, but this is a business and we saw it with AB (Alec Burks), a guy who was here eight years, and right before a game he was gone, and that’s it,”

Ricky Rubio on Alec Burks, Jan 25, 2019. Source: Deseret News.

item.title: Quin Snyder on Alec Burks
item.description:
Here's the full quote from head coach Snyder on where Burks' health currently stands:

“He's making really good progress. We're doing the same thing with Alec that we did with Dante. I think Dennis had a really good way of putting it, 'We're going to focus on the next 12 years over the next 12 months.' It's true with Alec. We just want to get him where he's comfortable and confident, and now's the right time to do that. He's going through everything that we're doing except he's not involved in contact stuff. I feel like he's getting more comfortable. And it's going to be the same thing where he's going to have to dust it off and get his timing back and get his habits back. But really everybody's in the same place with the habits.”

Quin Snyder on Alec Burks, Sep 28, 2016. Source: KSL.com.

item.title: Gordon Hayward on Alec Burks
item.description:
Andy Larsen:Hayward on Alec Burks:

“He was just caught in the air... I feel terrible for him, and hopefully he can have a speedy recovery.”

Gordon Hayward on Alec Burks, Dec 27, 2015. Source: Twitter @andyblarsen.

item.title: Gordon Hayward on Alec Burks
item.description:
Andy Larsen:Hayward on Alec Burks' injury:

“It looked like his leg was shaking, and he was in a rough place. It was tough to see. Everybody loves AB.”

Gordon Hayward on Alec Burks, Dec 27, 2015. Source: Twitter @andyblarsen.

item.title: DeMarre Carroll on Alec Burks
item.description:
“He really ain’t going to stand up for himself so ... I know I might not have all the money to give away but, hey, I’ll take a stand for my man Burks.”

DeMarre Carroll on Alec Burks, Feb 13, 2013. Source: Salt Lake Tribune.
